title: How Audit-Ready Are Your Ecommerce Books — Really?
summary: Take this 3-minute self-assessment to find out where your reconciliation, documentation, and close processes stand — before your auditor does.
body_markdown:
If you're managing accounting for an ecommerce business selling across Shopify, Amazon, or multiple marketplaces, you already know the complexity. Different platforms, different payout schedules, different fee structures — all flowing into the same set of books.


This assessment covers the 10 areas auditors look at most closely in ecommerce companies: transaction-level reconciliation, revenue documentation, fee matching, close speed, and more.


Answer honestly. There are no trick questions — just the same scenarios your team deals with every month.


**What you'll get:** Your personalized audit readiness score, a breakdown of where your biggest gaps are, and a clear picture of what "audit-ready" actually looks like for ecommerce finance teams.
